fusions.name: Pounce From Stillness
fusions.desc: Springs you onto a target up to 7 tiles away and rakes it, which deals 15 damage. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Full-Length Stretch
fusions.desc: A stretch with every claw out that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Nine-Tenths Asleep
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health and increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Do Not Disturb
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
